facts.text: I am planning to attend a language and culture conference next month.
I have been attending a weekly language exchange meetup at a local coffee shop in the past month.
I am interested in the keynote speaker's topic on code-switching in bilingual communities.
I am curious about how the speaker will address the role of code-switching in shaping identity and cultural affiliations, especially in immigrant communities.
I am wondering if the speaker will touch on the role of language exchange programs or cultural organizations in promoting linguistic diversity and supporting immigrant communities.

I am curious to know if the speaker will also discuss how language exchange programs and cultural organizations can collaborate with educational institutions to promote language education and cultural diversity.
I am interested in learning more about how language exchange programs and cultural organizations can leverage technology to support language learning and cultural exchange.
